scope: C11 two-flight-operation recoverable idempotency implementation pre-review

required_evidence.required: Before callback, persist claim operation/key/payload hash/resource binding; reject mismatched owner/order/quote/payment method/amount/currency; binding failure runs no callback. Same key from another owner exposes no response.

Enter possible-effect state before first commit/external call. ValueError-to-HTTPException translation and classification lookup errors must not release uncertain claim. Safe release requires positively proved no effect.

Recover only exact existing root/auth/capture/change keys; check payer, amount, currency, parents and CONFIRMED state. Unknown intent or movements do not authorize re-execute, refund, or TICKETED projection.

One original execution/recovery writer per same claim; different HTTP keys for same order/quote remain constrained by canonical operation. Failed complete/query preserves claim; retry returns precisely identified committed outcome.
PENDING_SUPPLIER stays pending until supplier evidence; released authorization cannot be revived with a replacement key; existing resolution owns capture/release and ticketing.

Preserve original red and prior PASS. New two-operation tests do not fix remaining 35 callsites. PostgreSQL cross-process concurrency, actual process termination/restart, real money/provider/browser remain HOLD unless executed with bound raw evidence.

implementation_risk_observed: Existing checkout_contract only explicitly blocks intent UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE before invoking money operations. New recovery must independently verify durable money states instead of assuming a returned capture ID proves a confirmed payment.
